FireCrawl.description: Integration with FireCrawl to provide advanced web scraping capabilities for extracting structured data from complex websites.

Github-Server.description: The GitHub MCP Server connects AI tools directly to GitHub's platform. This gives AI agents, assistants, and chatbots the ability to read repositories and code files, manage issues and PRs, analyze code, and automate workflows. All through natural language interactions.

Simple-Timeserver.description: Access accurate local and UTC time information.

Octocode.description: Integrates with GitHub CLI and npm to provide repository analysis, code discovery, file exploration, commit history tracking, and package metadata retrieval with intelligent caching and cross-tool workflow support.

arXiv-Research.description: Search and analyze scientific papers from arXiv.

Playwright.description: Automate web browsers for testing, scraping, and visual analysis.

Sequential-Thinking.description: Implements a structured sequential thinking process for breaking down complex problems, iteratively refining solutions, and exploring multiple reasoning paths.

Fetch.description: Retrieve and convert web content to markdown for analysis.

Web-Content-Pick.description: Extracts structured content from web pages using customizable selectors for crawling, parsing, and analyzing HTML elements without leaving the assistant interface.
